title: Integrating Network Pharmacology and In vivo Experimental Validation to Reveal the Mechanism of FuZheng YiLiu Formula on Estrogen Receptor Positive Breast Cancer.
authors: Xu, Yuan; Zhang, Ying-Xuan; Chen, Hong-Yu; Chang, Li-Sheng; Gou, Xiao-Jun; Chen, Wen-Li
one_liner_zh: 该文通过网络药理学和体内实验研究中药复方对ER+乳腺癌的作用机制，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE: FuZheng YiLiu Formula (FZYL) is a commonly used formula for postoperative estrogen receptor-positive (ER+) breast cancer and post-radiotherapy deficiency of both Qi and Yin. FZYL has been used in clinical practice for decades because of its ability to effectively improve the symptoms of deficiency in cancer patients. However, its mechanism needs to be further clarified. In this paper, we will observe the effect of FZYL on mice with ER+ breast cancer and explore the mechanism by which it improves the symptoms of ER+ breast cancer. MATERIALS AND METHODS: A tumor xenograft mouse model was established to detect tumor growth in vivo in order to evaluate the pharmacological effects of FZYL on ER+ breast cancer. The main targets of FZYL were identified by extracting the FZYL components and the corresponding potential target genes of breast cancer from the established database and constructing a proteinprotein interaction network of shared genes using the string database. GO functional annotation and KEGG pathway enrichment analysis were performed, and molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, western blotting analysis, and RT-qPCR were performed to confirm the validity of targets in the relevant pathways. RESULTS: FZYL was able to significantly reduce the size of tumors in vivo and had a significant therapeutic effect on tumor xenograft mice. GO and KEGG pathway enrichment analyses indicated that the effects of FZYL may be mediated by oxidative stress levels, apoptotic signaling pathways, and cell cycle proliferation. By RT-qPCR and protein blotting assays, FZYL targeted the key targets of TP53, JUN, ESR1, RELA, MYC, and MAPK1 to exert its effects. The key active components of FZYL are quercetin, luteolin, stigmasterol, and glycitein. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulation results further demonstrated that the key active components of FZYL are stably bound to the core targets. CONCLUSION: In this study, the potential active ingredients, potential core targets, key biological pathways, and signaling pathways involved in the treatment of breast cancer with FZYL were identified, providing a theoretical basis for further anti ER+ breast cancer research.
abstract_zh: 背景与目的：扶正抑瘤方（FZYL）是术后雌激素受体阳性（ER+）乳腺癌及放疗后气阴两虚证的常用方剂。FZYL因其能有效改善癌症患者虚证症状，已在临床使用数十年。然而，其作用机制尚需进一步阐明。本文旨在观察FZYL对ER+乳腺癌小鼠的作用，并探讨其改善ER+乳腺癌症状的机制。材料与方法：建立肿瘤异种移植小鼠模型，检测体内肿瘤生长，以评估FZYL对ER+乳腺癌的药理作用。通过从已建立数据库中提取FZYL成分及相应的乳腺癌潜在靶基因，并利用STRING数据库构建共享基因的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络，鉴定FZYL的主要靶点。进行GO功能注释和KEGG通路富集分析，并采用分子对接、分子动力学模拟、Western blotting分析和RT-qPCR验证相关通路中靶点的有效性。结果：FZYL能显著减小体内肿瘤体积，对肿瘤异种移植小鼠具有显著治疗作用。GO和KEGG通路富集分析表明，FZYL的作用可能通过氧化应激水平、凋亡信号通路和细胞周期增殖介导。通过RT-qPCR和蛋白印迹分析，FZYL靶向TP53、JUN、ESR1、RELA、MYC和MAPK1等关键靶点发挥其作用。FZYL的关键活性成分为槲皮素、木犀草素、豆甾醇和黄豆黄素。分子对接和分子动力学模拟结果进一步证明，FZYL的关键活性成分与核心靶点稳定结合。结论：本研究鉴定了FZYL治疗乳腺癌所涉及的潜在活性成分、潜在核心靶点、关键生物学通路和信号通路，为进一步抗ER+乳腺癌研究提供了理论基础。
